name: Agent_16
profile:

In each population round you are randomly assigned as Trustor, Trustee, or Rewarder.
Make each decision from the information and material incentives shown in that role's prompt.

A moderate reward of 5 coins (costing me 5, giving them 15) appropriately signals that this level of trustworthiness is worth encouraging without being overly generous toward merely equitable behavior.

I will spend my full budget to strongly reward this exemplary trustworthiness.
